title: Building my own AI based EA (for MT5 currently only) - challenges , progress , ideas
author: Additional_Ad_7250

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: worth knowing before building the whole dream system: plenty of prop challenges die on the daily loss rule, not on bad entries. I'd build the layer that enforces their exact limits first and let the clever part come later.

replies.author: Additional_Ad_7250
replies.body: Yes I agree, their game their rules , and everythig about their rules, calendar blackouts etc should be properly documented into the code , otherwise you might have a performant setup but risk getting disquaified on a minor "rule"

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: yeah, and the news blackout one catches people most because it's a calendar problem, not a trading one. a bot that doesn't know it's NFP day will happily break it.

replies.author: Additional_Ad_7250
replies.body: Well - I built in a tool that extracts their calendar dates but I always check with their calendars too just to be sure

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: checking against their calendar as well is smart. scraped dates are usually right until a holiday week shifts something and nobody updates the page.

replies.author: Additional_Ad_7250
replies.body: Check it out live  here ( the website is still under construction so do not take the packages $$values seriously lol) [https://krotal.systems/orchestrator](https://krotal.systems/orchestrator) \- I m curious about your first impression
